explanation: Generated an EXCLURAD input for the eta (ep -> e'p eta) configuration: a 3x3 grid over W = {1.55, 1.65, 1.75} GeV and Q^2 = {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} GeV^2 (9 points total), all at cos(theta*) = 0 and phi* = 90 deg. Used the eta-channel defaults from eta/input.dat and eta/examples/input_single_chunk.dat: model=3 (maid2000/EtaMAID-2023), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) correction), bmom=6.535 GeV (CLAS12 beam momentum), tmom=0, lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (standard CLAS12 inelasticity cut). Kinematics are physically valid: W is above the eta production threshold W_thr ~ 1.4856 GeV (m_p + m_eta), and Q^2 lies within the EtaMAID-2023 table range (0-5 GeV^2, per mpintp.inc). The 9 points fit within the 10-points-per-file limit of the Fortran list-directed reader, so no chunking across multiple files was needed.
